title: 주광 요일별 실제 분배·출고일 원자 저장
nativeCustomerLink: Locked Master is the customer authority. Allow native raw detail CustKey NULL through the shared helper while preserving the raw NULL in digests/readback and existing UPDATE. Explicit zero/other non-NULL key and all fix/date/money/stock/stale/atomic rollback checks remain blocked.

calendarTimestampContract.source: PeriodDay.BaseYmd (운영 nvarchar) and ShipmentDate.ShipmentDtm (datetime), EXE exact datetime join
calendarTimestampContract.serialization: Convert BaseYmd explicitly to SQL datetime with style 121 before nvarchar(23) style 121; never compare date-only truncations or use JS timezone coercion
calendarTimestampContract.positiveFixture: nvarchar date-only BaseYmd and datetime midnight shipment support same-total 20 to 15 plus 5 day move

actions.name: DRAFT_EDIT
actions.rule: 초안은 명시 ERP 저장 전 원장을 변경하지 않는다. 저장 전 인쇄와 저장 확정본을 구분한다.

actions.name: SAVE_EXISTING_DAY_QUANTITY
actions.stock: normal weekday API: scoped cancel old/fix new stock transitions; internal legacy calls preserve previous fixed-delta policy
actions.rule: 잠긴 상세 및 exact business identity/snapshot/date/unit/price 검사. 일반 주광 API는 confirmationLifecycle 계약의 확정 취소·수량 저장·재확정을 같은 transaction에서 수행한다. early 내부 호출은 기존 정책 유지. 대표일은 EXE 마지막 양수 날짜이며 로그·native 재계산·readback 원자 적용.

actions.name: MOVE_DAYS_AND_BUSINESS_WEEKS
actions.rule: 복수 상세/모호한 단가/날짜/연도는 임의 합산이나 추정 없이 차단. 미지원 신규 대상은 성공으로 처리하지 않는다.

actions.name: OPERATION_REPLAY
actions.rule: 동일 UUID+사용자+payload hash의 committed 결과만 반환한다. 다른 payload 재사용은409. 응답불명은 status조회만 하며 신규UUID 자동재시도 금지.

actions.name: READ_AUDIT_AND_PRINT
actions.rule: 영속 before/after·확정단계·소비량·사용자·사유 조회. 선택요일은 선택업체 실제 출고일의 양수 상세 전체 확정 및 연결 검사, 전체견적은 기존 전체대차수 검사. EXE-compatible 저장 확정본만 SQL/HTML 출력, 초안 제외.

actions.name: RESERVE_HISTORY_SAFE_DETAIL_KEY
actions.rule: 주광 완전 취소 후 기존 adjust/distribute/stock-status/import 메뉴도 같은 ShipmentDetail/SdetailKey 전용 allocator로 위임한다. 활성 상세·잔존 이력·KeyNumbering 세 상한보다 큰 키를 사용한다. 다른 테이블 채번과 각 메뉴 주문·분배·확정 정책은 변경하지 않는다.

actions.name: APPLY_ALLOCATION_FINAL_QUANTITIES
actions.shipmentMaster: create missing exact-scope master unfixed; normal weekday lifecycle derives touched master from all surviving children
actions.shipmentDate: preserve untouched dates; explicit exact-calendar final values
actions.stock: normal API consumedDelta confirmation transitions and native cascade; internal early wrapper previous behavior; positive allocation availability guard remains
actions.customerProdCost: read unique native price for new detail only; duplicate blocks
actions.rule: 100 to120 means delta20; reapply120 no-op. New quantity-only allocation stays unfixed. Existing normal weekday edits follow confirmationLifecycle. All absence/digest/unit/calendar/price locks remain authoritative.
actions.orderPolicy: ADD with active same-year order preserves it; ADD without active order creates positive order only; CANCEL preserves
actions.quantityPolicy: absolute final quantity; confirmationLifecycle for normal API, previous confirmation policy for internal early wrapper

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 동일 세부차수·업체·품목 sentinel을 두고 2026 대상만 변경한다. 다차수 작업의 각 항목은 명시 연도와 정확한 PeriodDay를 재검증한다.

allocationMode.newPrice: unique CustomerProdCost Cost or native absent0; preserve existing physical prices
allocationMode.transaction: gate, lease, complete snapshot, absolute dates, native unit conversion, stock, before/after audit and UUID atomically

existing unfixed quantity-only modifies without confirming; date movement confirms first
no active current-year order positive ADD creates positive order

confirmationLifecycle.authority: trusted normal weekday API dependency only; early-shipment internal wrapper preserves previous behavior
confirmationLifecycle.fixedQuantity: cancel exact detail, return old stock, save quantity, refix exact detail, consume new stock, then move dates
confirmationLifecycle.unfixedDate: confirm then move dates; combined quantity is saved first
confirmationLifecycle.group: year+customer+product date decreases and increases across requested subweeks classify movement
confirmationLifecycle.zero: cancel if fixed and purge; no empty confirmation
confirmationLifecycle.stock: consumedDelta=finalFixed*newTotal-beforeFixed*oldTotal; native cascading recalculation and negative snapshot validation
confirmationLifecycle.master: derive touched master status from all surviving children; never change other children
confirmationLifecycle.audit: before/final confirmation flags, intent, stages and scoped stock transitions stored atomically; rollback does not retain success audit
confirmationLifecycle.print: selected-day quote validates selected customer active selected-date details; major quote retains major guard
